# ASKSINGAPORE.AI

> Singapore AI concierge — a premium .ai domain presented by Noustelos Studio as part of the "Ask" concierge network. The domain asksingapore.ai is available for acquisition.

This is a single-page site with a live AI chat: answers are generated in real time by Agnes AI (agnes-ai.com), a Singapore-built model, via a lightweight serverless proxy on this domain. The chat is a live demonstration of what asksingapore.ai could become in a buyer's hands. AI answers can contain inaccuracies. There is no data collection and there are no user accounts.

## Acquisition

- The domain asksingapore.ai is for sale. Enquiries: info@asksantorini.ai
